title: 说话算作一个动作，导致自己或NPC在做其他事时无法交谈，且必须紧挨着才能说话
description: 说话算作一个动作，导致自己或NPC在做其他事时无法交谈，且必须紧挨着才能说话
evidence: Everyone including your character can only do one action at a time, and since talking counts as an action that means you can't speak to anyone while you or they are doing anything. You also have to be directly next to somebody to speak to them
